review_method: Exact source-location and source-flow inspection. Raw inventory establishes the current denominator only and does not confer authorization.
denominator_definition: SECRET_READ outside public-risk, ambiguity, and foreign-direct sets on APPLICATION_RUNTIME or ACTIVE OPERATIONAL_SCRIPT surfaces.

classification_definitions.OWNER_INTERNAL_VALID: Owner-context runtime access with no public secret-bearing response.
classification_definitions.APPROVED_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY: Exact manual operator capability that consumes an owner credential for a provider operation.
classification_definitions.REDACTED_SAFE: Secret-bearing database read whose reviewed operator flow emits only non-secret metadata or presence state.
classification_definitions.APPROVED_OPERATOR_CREDENTIAL_DIAGNOSTIC: Exact manual operator credential diagnostic bounded to its tracked command and terminal.
classification_definitions.APPROVED_CREDENTIAL_IMPORT_CAPABILITY: Exact manual local credential import bounded to the fleet acquisition operator command.
classification_definitions.APPROVED_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY: Exact source-bound application-runtime capability that carries a provider secret only through independently reviewed non-public consumers or projectors.
